headline: A 1996 executive order created a new military award called the Armed Forces Service Medal.
what_it_does: This order creates the Armed Forces Service Medal, a decoration for members of the US armed forces. No summary was provided, so the details of who qualifies and how the medal is awarded are not described here. The order is an award for recognition and does not appear to involve pay or benefits.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the US armed forces
who_it_affects.how: Service members who meet the order's requirements can receive this new medal.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the source. Executive orders usually take effect when signed, which here was January 11, 1996.
